findings.summary: The test 'starts an ungrouped task whatever the group state' queues one grouped task and one ungrouped task. It adds little over the first test. It would be stronger with a held group (inflight or live executor) plus an ungrouped task, and with the group field cleared. This is not blocking.

findings.summary: A skipped group member never goes into heldIds or the report, so with the open-PR limit active a group-skipped task is not reported as held. This is harmless, because it is not startable anyway.
